title: Larry Susskind on Kurt Jaimungal's podcast calls string theory a failure

tellings.quote: Larry uh Larry Suskin just went on Kirch Mungle's podcast and basically It was quite shocking to hear this guy uh you know leading light of string theory guy you know getting towards the end of his career. He's just like yeah it was complete fail failure. It's basically pointless. Everyone should start over.

plain: The physicist Leonard Susskind, a leading figure in string theory (an attempt to explain all of physics as tiny vibrating strings), went on the podcast of the interviewer Curt Jaimungal in 2024 and said the theory had been a complete failure, basically pointless, and that everyone should start over. The security analyst Matthew Pines passes this on to Michels and says he found it shocking to hear from a man near the end of his career, because it suggests mainstream physics may have stalled.
